payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show the background changed into a basketball court?
node.criteria: Pass if the background as a whole is recognizably a basketball court, considering the visible scene together: court surface and markings, hoop or other basketball equipment, and how these elements combine to establish a court setting. Do not let a dark or plain upper backdrop alone outweigh clear court cues elsewhere in the background. Basketball equipment alone does not establish a court. Fail if the background is clearly not recognizable as a basketball court. Unknown if the visual evidence does not reliably settle whether the background reads as a court.
node.binding: Judge completion of the requested background replacement from the entire visible background, not just the upper backdrop or isolated objects. Weigh court surface, markings, equipment, and surrounding context together; do not require any unsupported specific feature or force a conclusion at an ambiguous threshold.
